Examples.Title: Upload audio file
Examples.Description:
Upload an audio file to a temporary storage before creating an animation.
The audio is uploaded using multipart/form-data. the filename directive is optional and if provided should contain up to 50 valid characters long.
The resulting file is stored as a .wav file in a 16kHz sample rate.
Valid characters: a-z A-Z 0-9 . _ -
Supported mime types: "audio/, video/"
Storage duration: 24-48H
Examples.Code:
### Upload audio file
# @name Upload an audio
POST {{host}}/audios
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=AutoSDKBoundary
Accept: application/json

--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="audio"; filename="audio.bin"
Content-Type: application/octet-stream

< ./audio.bin
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="source_url"

string
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="result_url"

string
--AutoSDKBoundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="persist"

string
--AutoSDKBoundary--

## Responses
# 201
# Description: The audio has been uploaded successfully
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: BadRequestError | InvalidFileSizeError | InvalidAudioDurationError
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: AuthorizationError
# Content-Type: application/json
# 402
# Description: InsufficientCreditsError
# Content-Type: application/json
# 415
# Description: UnsupportedMimeTypeError
# Content-Type: application/json
# 451
# Description: AudioModerationError
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Create chat logs
Examples.Description:
Create a chat log export for `agent_id` containing all of the Agent's chats.

Use the `export_id` in the GET chat logs endpoint to get the result of the create chat logs request (zipped JSON files).

(The chat log export will be deleted from the database after 7 days from the export creation date)
Examples.Code:

# @name Create chat logs
POST {{host}}/agents/chats/exports
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "agent_id": "string",
  "from": "2024-05-15T12:00:00Z",
  "to": "2024-05-15T12:00:00Z",
  "persistent_chats": true,
  "token": "string"
}

# 400
